entries.reason: the armv7 shared cache of iOS 6.1.3 exports no such symbol: it arrived in iOS 8, and the release's own declaration walk (UTTypeCopyChildIdentifiers, UTTypeConformsTo, UTTypeCopyDeclaration) is what it would have to be written over, which is the next piece of work and not a guess to be shipped unmeasured
entries.effect: the function is not there: a weak reference to it is NULL, and an application that checks for it before calling is told the truth
entries.source: the armv7 shared cache of iOS 6.1.3, whose MobileCoreServices exports UTTypeConformsTo, UTTypeCopyChildIdentifiers, UTTypeCopyDeclaration, UTTypeCreatePreferredIdentifierForTag and UTTypeCopyDeclaringBundleURL and no UTTypeCopyAllTagsWithClass; the header of CoreServices/UTType.h in the SDK 16.4, which marks it deprecated in favour of the UTType class
